tiers.lead: Main session and orchestration; Backend and Frontend implementation, QA test authoring, DevOps, Copywriter, SEO, Designer preview, repair fixes.
tiers.advisor: PM, Gherkin, Architect, Designer spec and review, API contract; QA gate, Security, independent code review; advisor consults.
tiers.swarm: Read-only search and repo maps, file inventories, log and test-output triage, check runs.
tiers.worker: Bulk scoped work delegated by the lead via delegate_task (T3 only): implementation, tests, refactors, searches. Never plans, design, contracts, security, or any gate.
